record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:138 — For recurring bookings only this one occurrence gets the new attendees, but the event carries the eventType recurringEvent, so the new guest's ICS invites them to the whole series

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the DB update only adds attendees to the single `bookingId` record (`prisma.booking.update({ where: { id: bookingId }, ... attendees.createMany ... })`), but the constructed `CalendarEvent` passed into email/ICS generation always includes `recurringEvent: parseRecurringEvent(booking.eventType?.recurringEvent)`. For bookings created from a recurring event type, this means the outgoing ICS (via `generateIcsString({ event: this.calEvent, ... })` in the new add-guests email templates) can include recurrence/series information even though only one booking occurrence was actually updated, inviting guests to more than the updated occurrence.
